_about: External reference figures for budgets and secondary research. Add cost benchmarks, outcome rates and district indicators here as they are sourced.

figures.name: Cap on a company's CSR administrative overheads
figures.unit: % of total CSR expenditure for the year
figures.source_name: Companies (Corporate Social Responsibility Policy) Rules, 2014, rule 7(1), as amended on 22 January 2021
figures.notes: Applies to the company's own CSR administration, not to an NGO's project budget; funders set their own limits for grantee overheads.
